description:
The project 'DateUtilsLegacy' is currently a plain Java project in Eclipse that uses a manually added Joda-Time JAR (lib/joda-time-2.12.5.jar) on its build path. Convert this project to a Maven project and replace the manual JAR dependency with a proper Maven dependency.

Steps to complete:
1. Right-click the 'DateUtilsLegacy' project in Package Explorer and select Configure > Convert to Maven Project
2. In the Maven POM creation dialog, set:
   - Group ID: com.legacy.dateutils
   - Artifact ID: DateUtilsLegacy
   - Version: 1.0.0
   - Packaging: jar
   Click Finish to create the pom.xml
3. Open the generated pom.xml and add the Joda-Time dependency:
   - Group ID: joda-time
   - Artifact ID: joda-time
   - Version: 2.12.5
4. Save the pom.xml
5. If needed, right-click the project > Maven > Update Project to resolve dependencies
6. Verify the project has no compilation errors

The project contains three Java source files (DateFormatter.java, DateCalculator.java, App.java) in package com.legacy.dateutils that use Joda-Time's DateTime, Period, and DateTimeFormat classes. All source files must remain intact and the project must compile successfully after conversion.
